input_brief: We are building an AI assistant that helps SMB founders understand their financial runway and unit economics in real time based on banking data and simple questions.

slides.title: Problem
slides.goal: Explain why SMB founders lack financial visibility.
key_points: SMB founders struggle to understand runway and unit economics.
Existing tools are built for CFOs, not non-finance founders.
Decisions are often made on gut feeling.
slides.visuals_description: Founders surrounded by messy spreadsheets and dashboards.

slides.title: Solution
slides.goal: Introduce FinSight AI as an AI-native finance copilot.
key_points: Connects to bank accounts and accounting tools.
Turns raw data into plain-language insights and alerts.
slides.visuals_description: Dashboard mockup plus chat window with insights.

slides.title: Market
key_points: Initial beachhead: digital-first SMBs with 5-50 employees.

slides.title: Business Model
key_points: Tiered pricing by number of accounts and seats.

slides.title: Team
slides.goal: Establish why this team can win.
key_points: Ex-CFO and ex-ML lead from neobank.
slides.visuals_description: Photo collage of team with titles.

slides.title: Financials
key_points: Low marginal cost per additional customer.

slides.title: Ask
slides.goal: Clarify funding ask and use of funds.

input_brief: Cloud platform that optimizes charging schedules for EV fleets using real-time electricity prices and grid carbon intensity, targeting logistics companies in Europe.

slides.title: Problem
slides.goal: Show the pain for EV fleet operators.
key_points: EV fleets face high and volatile charging costs.
Charging at the wrong time increases grid emissions.
Manual scheduling does not scale beyond a few vehicles.
slides.visuals_description: Fleet of vans plugged in at a depot with a graph overlay of costs.

slides.title: Solution
key_points: Schedules charging when energy is cheapest and cleanest.
Integrates with existing telematics and depot systems.
slides.visuals_description: Architecture diagram of platform between grid data and fleet.

slides.title: Market
key_points: Regulation is pushing fleets to decarbonize now.
Annual software spend per fleet is growing.

slides.title: Team
key_points: Founders from energy trading and EV telematics.

slides.title: Ask
key_points: Expanding data integrations and optimization models.
slides.visuals_description: Use of funds segmented by R&D, sales, and operations.

input_brief: Web app that uses AI to turn a founder interview into an investor-ready pitch deck, including narrative structure, slide copy, and visual suggestions.

slides.title: Problem
slides.goal: Articulate why pitch creation is broken.
key_points: Non-designers struggle to make slides look professional.
slides.visuals_description: Clock and messy slides next to a polished deck.

slides.title: Solution
key_points: Generates a full pitch deck with copy and design system.
Keeps decks in sync with latest metrics.
slides.visuals_description: Screenshot of interview UI and resulting deck.

slides.title: Market
slides.goal: Explain who needs this and how big it is.
key_points: Hundreds of thousands of new decks each year.
Target early-stage startups and accelerators first.
Expansion into sales and internal decks later.

slides.title: Traction
key_points: Strong qualitative feedback on clarity and speed.

slides.title: Team
key_points: Advisors from accelerators and design agencies.

slides.title: Financials
key_points: High LTV due to multiple decks per founder.

slides.title: Ask
slides.visuals_description: Use of funds and key hires visual.
